claim_stack.statement: A support triple is a counted Kobon triangular face iff its three pairwise intersections are distinct/noncollinear and its three side segments are arrangement edges between consecutive arrangement vertices; equivalently, counted triangular faces are the nondegenerate 3-cycles of the arrangement graph.

Conditional on the named predecessor source-scoped local-fan/no-consecutive-D1 and clean-line charging premises, the sole q=5 score-95 equality normal form (a D2 triangle of triple cores plus two isolated triple cores) is unrealizable. Hence any normalized n=18,T=95 witness satisfying those premises must have q>=6 finite multiple points.
Three exact/bounded search tranches from the verified 93 construction found no 94 candidate in their explicitly defined neighborhoods.
